verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs say it can 'automatically block out-of-policy purchases, with preset rules and limits'. It also offers auto-enforced spend limits, managed in the product and through the Budgets API, which covers amount-based restriction and blocking of out-of-policy spend. The evidence never explicitly documents restricting cards by merchant category or by specific merchant, and does not detail decline-at-point-of-sale mechanics. Missing for 10: documented category/MCC restrictions, merchant-level allow/block lists, explicit point-of-sale decline or auto-lock behavior, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can restrict cards by category, merchant, and amount — and the platform auto-locks or declines out-of-policy spend at the point of sale
